title.ph: Global EHS Vision, Mission and Values

othermeta.content: global ehs vision mission and values
othermeta.name: title

othermeta.content: outlines the organisation wide EHS vision mission and values to embed safety into strategic planning and culture
othermeta.name: shortdesc

othermeta.content: articulates the long term EHS vision to achieve sustained zero incidents and embed safety into the business strategy
othermeta.name: shortdesc

ol.li: Space is committed to achieve a global workplace with zero environment, occupational health or safety incidents.
EHS incidents include all injuries and environmental non-compliance issues.

othermeta.content: states the EHS mission emphasising prevention leadership and integration of safety into operations and talent development
othermeta.name: shortdesc

ol.li: Empower our people and engage our communities to achieve zero incidents. Through leading practices, we implement global, sustainable and innovative collaborative solutions. We enable learning, recognize achievements, and continuously improve.

We are committed to achieve a zero incident workplace through our people – by providing them with the resources, tools and leadership support to see and solve problems that could lead to an EHS incident.

We focus on applying leading practices by collaborating with local, regional and national communities across regions, and using internal and external ideas to create sustainable, collaborative, innovative solutions.
We are committed to being a learning organization; to recognize and reward EHS employees and our partners in the functions and businesses; and to improve our processes and results every day.

othermeta.content: presents the five core EHS principles to guide behaviour decision making and risk reduction across the plant
othermeta.name: shortdesc

conbody.p: These principles describe how we will deliver a zero EHS incidents workplace. They drive our culture, strategic planning, EHS processes, talent management, and metrics.

othermeta.content: sets the principle that incidents and near misses must be reported investigated and prevented through corrective actions and learning
othermeta.name: shortdesc

conbody.p: All EHS incidents are preventable. We focus on root causes to find solutions to solve current issues and prevent a repeat incident anywhere in the world.

othermeta.content: defines leadership and workforce roles to establish shared accountability for EHS and drive a zero incident culture in glass manufacturing plants
othermeta.name: shortdesc

conbody.p: Preventing EHS incidents is the responsibility of every one of our 21,500 employees. While employees in different roles have different responsibilities, all employees are expected to help us reach zero EHS incidents.

othermeta.content: describes systematic hazard identification risk assessment and control measures to reduce workplace risk in glass plants
othermeta.name: shortdesc

conbody.p: EHS incidents start with risk and end in an incident. We work to identify risks or problems before they become an incident, and identify sustainable solutions through risk reduction.

othermeta.content: promotes a no blame reporting culture that focuses on learning system failures and implementing preventive measures
othermeta.name: shortdesc

conbody.p: When there is an incident, leadership and the global EHS team are committed to solve the problem, share the solution globally, and avoid laying blame for the past.

title.ph: Never put production ahead of EHS

othermeta.content: never put production ahead of ehs
othermeta.name: title

othermeta.content: establishes the principle that safety decisions override production pressure and defines stop work and escalation procedures
othermeta.name: shortdesc

conbody.p: Employees often must make decisions that could risk an EHS incident in order to meet business needs. Space leadership is committed to create a culture where these situations are openly discussed, where alternative actions are assessed, and where economic considerations do not automatically come before EHS.
